Claim 3 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on a minimum desired throughput for each particular node in the local contention neighborhood.

Claim 4 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node __relative to__ an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more nodes interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

Claim 14 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast the dynamic weight associated with the second node to the first node based on a determination of inter-node transmission rates.

Claim 17 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point; wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node interferes with communication between the second node and the second access point, wherein the interference is characterized by a reduction in successful communication attempts.
